verdict.rationale: Devin documents a public API, so this axis applies, but the pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and markdown docs are a documentation index, not a machine-readable API spec, so they get no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
